title: No item or action heals a companion outside specific hearths. After the honour guard fight Brother Osk was left at 2/8 hp; every 'use X' consumable (dried herbs, wild herbs, tithe-bread, dried peas) healed only me, and the only party-wide heal found all game was 'rest by the fire' at the Last Light Inn. Deep in the palace crypts, far from any hearth, a companion can be stranded critically wounded with no way to help them.
where: Marrowgate / The Old Crypts (after fighting the honour guard)
